expect_red: a sphere read from ONE BAND of quads is OTHER, and says which refusal it is -- two coaxial circles lie on a sphere whatever shape they bound

mutations.contract: A face whose nodes sit in exactly two rows is two coaxial circles, and any two coaxial circles lie on one sphere EXACTLY, whatever surface joins them. So a sphere fitted to a band is not evidence of anything -- and the refusal has to be on the face's SHAPE, because no residual threshold can separate a band that is a sphere from one that is a cone.
mutations.note: The mutation deletes the band refusal and leaves every residual test in place, which is exactly the version a reader who trusted the residuals would write. Measured on the installed MS14101-3 bearing, that version answers `spherical` for 20 of its 36 faces -- the chamfer bands, the swage lips and the bore relief -- each with a centre and a radius a solver would take at face value.
